# DocumentDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A Document Definition: plain JSON data. Its shape is checked by [`validateDefinition`](validate-definition.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

## Properties

- [`$schema`](#$schema): Optional URL of the JSON Schema that describes this document.
- [`attachments`](#attachments): Files to attach to the PDF.
- [`metadata`](#metadata): Document metadata, using the same keys as `DocumentMetadataOptions`.
- [`minorVersion`](#minorversion): Minor version of the definition format the document was written for.
- [`pages`](#pages): The pages of the document, each holding its elements.
- [`resources`](#resources): Named resources (images, fonts, SVG and attachments) that elements refer to by name.
- [`settings`](#settings): Document settings, using the same keys as `DocumentSettingsOptions`.
- [`version`](#version): Major version of the definition format.
